Shake your device to give Home Screen icons **gravity**. Tilt to move them, touch to attract them, and shake again to restore.

Targeted at **iOS 27.0.1**; should work on other devices, but **untested**.

**Creator:** kritanta (the-big-mango)

Modified port of Gravitation by kritanta.

[Repo](https://the-big-mango.github.io/repo/) · [GitHub](https://github.com/the-big-mango)
